title: Repo static facts (facts.json)
description: Deterministic, AST/XML-derived facts for one repo/service, produced by scripts/extract/index.mjs. Consumed by dependency-analysis and other skills as ground truth for symbol/endpoint/table existence, per skills/static-index/SKILL.md's consult-first contract. Not a substitute for reading source to understand logic/semantics.

service_id.description: From .workspace-profile.md, or null in single-repo mode

error.description: Present only if this file failed to parse; other fields are empty arrays in that case

symbols.description: Classes/interfaces/components, with any framework annotations/decorators and their methods

table_name.description: From @Table(name=...) on a @Entity class; null if @Entity has no explicit @Table

repository_entity_type.description: First generic type arg, e.g. JpaRepository<Invoice, Long> -> "Invoice"

endpoints.description: REST/WS endpoints this file exposes (backend only)

outbound_calls.description: Calls this file makes to another host/service (frontend HTTP client calls, backend service-to-service clients). Cross-referenced against .workspace-profile.md base_url/aliases by dependency-analysis to distinguish cross-service calls from genuine external systems.

url_expression.description: Literal URL/path if statically known; null if fully dynamic

dynamic_suffix.description: True if the URL has a non-literal suffix (e.g. string concatenation with a variable)

evidence.description: e.g. client_type:RestTemplate when only the client type is known, not a URL

db_access.description: Data-access statements from MyBatis mapper XML or JPA repository interfaces (@Query / derived-query methods). `source` distinguishes origin; MyBatis entries have `result_map` and real `tables`, JPQL/derived JPA entries have `entity_type` instead of `tables` (JPQL/derived queries reference the entity, not the physical table — join against that entity's own `table_name` in `symbols` to get the real table).

tables.description: Populated for MyBatis and JPA native @Query(nativeQuery=true); empty for JPQL/derived (see entity_type instead)

entity_type.description: JPA only: the entity type this query operates on (from the repository's generic type argument)

query_text.description: JPA @Query only: the raw JPQL/SQL string

criteria_fields.description: JPA derived-query only: field names parsed from the method name (e.g. findByStatusAndCustomerId -> ["Status", "CustomerId"])
